script_text: Stop! Aries, the fire in your stars is screaming at you now. Mars, your ruling planet, is forming a tense square to the Moon in your 5th House of romance and 8th House of shared resources, igniting passionate but chaotic emotions. This fiery aspect demands you channel your raw energy carefully, as impulsive actions could ripple into your bonds. The intensity peaks at noon, so plan key interactions accordingly. If you're single, the electric vibe draws intense admirers, but beware of obsessive connections. If you're taken, power struggles over intimacy or finances may surface, requiring honest dialogue. Saturn in your 11th House of networks is sextiling Mars, offering structured opportunities through friends or professional groups—leverage your bold ideas for tangible rewards. Avoid signing contracts under emotional pressure; instead, embrace the unexpected gift of clarity that arrives through a sudden conversation. Follow for tomorrow's reading to navigate this cosmic storm.
